conceptName: The bottle that outlasts the recipe
concept: A recipe gets handed down and rewritten across generations, but the oil in the kitchen cupboard is the one thing that never actually changed — Filtered Groundnut Oil is what stayed constant while everything else drifted.
hook: Three generations rewrote the recipe. Nobody ever changed the oil.
tension: A family argues about how the dish should be made while never noticing what's stayed exactly the same the whole time.
sendTo: The grandmother who insists her version is the only correct one
strategicRole: Turn recipes-serving into a brand-owned argument.

gate.rationale: Uses exact RRO portfolio and SKU context, names a specific family friction and a specific recipient distinct from the 'similar' fixture's own concept.
